2609.30982.title: FARE: Forensic Acceptance Region Estimation for Catching Bait-and-Switch Image Generators
2609.30982.paper_summary: Modern AI image generators are increasingly deployed as opaque APIs, where customers can query the deployed service, but cannot inspect model weights or architecture. This creates a practical challenge: a provider may pass governance certification with one generator and later silently switch to a cheaper and lower-quality one for deployment, compromising public trust or even safety in high-stakes domains. We study integrity auditing at deployment time and propose FARE (Forensic Acceptance Region Estimation). A certified generator is enrolled by training FARE on images sampled from that generator. After deployment, FARE can determine whether a generated image is consistent with the enrolled generator---using only that image. FARE's features are based on image generator-specific artifacts that have been proposed for forensic applications. FARE amplifies these features during training by finding hard samples that tighten the acceptance region and increase sensitivity to subtle changes in the certified generator. Across generator swaps, including substitutions with similar model versions and model variants, FARE is effective at detecting swaps, consistently outperforming existing baselines at strict operating points, and remains effective under the exact-model and decision-only attacks evaluated in this work.
2609.30982.paper_summary_zh: 現代的 AI 圖像生成器越來越多地被作為不透明的 API 部署，客戶可以查詢已部署的服務，但無法檢查模型權重或架構。這帶來了一個實際挑戰：提供者可能在一個生成器上通過治理認證，然後在部署時默默切換到一個更便宜且質量較低的生成器，從而損害公共信任甚至在高風險領域的安全性。我們研究了部署時的完整性審計，並提出了 FARE（法醫接受區域估計）。通過對從該生成器中採樣的圖像進行訓練，將一個經認證的生成器註冊到 FARE 中。部署後，FARE 可以僅使用該圖像來判斷生成的圖像是否與註冊的生成器一致。FARE 的特徵基於已被提議用於法醫應用的圖像生成器特定工件。FARE 在訓練過程中通過尋找困難樣本來放大這些特徵，這些樣本收緊接受區域並提高對認證生成器中微妙變化的敏感性。在生成器交換中，包括與相似模型版本和模型變體的替換，FARE 在檢測交換方面非常有效，始終在嚴格的操作點上超越現有基準，並在本研究中評估的精確模型和僅決策攻擊下仍然有效。
2609.30982.author: Kai Yao et.al.
